functions.name: FDebugSubstep
functions.docs: Debug only class used to control the pausing/stepping/substepping of a debug solver thread.

functions.name: ProgressToSubstep
functions.docs: Allow progress to the next substep (only works once this object is enabled).

functions.name: ProgressToStep
functions.docs: Allow progress to the next step (only works once this object is enabled).

functions.name: Release
functions.docs: Shutdown and release sync events. Once released the debug thread cannot be restarted unless Initialize is called first.

functions.name: Shutdown
functions.docs:
Disable and wait for the completion of the debug thread.
Not thread safe. Must be called from within the physics thread or with the physics thread locked.
Once shutdown, the debug thread can still be restarted when SyncAdvance is called.

functions.name: AssumeThisThread
functions.docs: Set the id of the thread the debug substepping will be running in.

functions.name: SyncAdvance
Add
Start
functions.docs: Set sync events to start the substepping process.

functions.name: Stop
functions.docs: Trigger/wait for sync events to stop the substepping process.

functions.name: Substep
functions.docs: Trigger/wait for sync events to step/substep.
